name: code_intelligence
description:
Find source-scoped code symbols or textual references in registered local source directories. Use this before broad file reads when you need declaration-like locations, call/reference lines, or a quick code map for a named function, type, component, command, or domain term.

This is a lightweight local code intelligence tool, not a full language server. It scans readable code/text files under the current source scope, respects source permissions and gitignore-style traversal, skips heavy build folders, and returns line-numbered matches plus structured artifacts.

action.description: Use symbols to find declaration-like function/type/class/interface definitions. Use references to find source lines that mention a symbol or term.

query.description: Symbol name, name fragment, identifier, or term to find

path.description: Optional file or directory path to scan. If omitted, scans all directories in the current source scope.

whole_word.description: For references, match identifier-like queries as whole words only (default true)

include_hidden.description: Include dotfiles and hidden directories (default false)
